description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the Audit module within SuiteCRM. It contains unit tests for Audit object instantiation, summary text retrieval, audit list retrieval, and associated field name resolution.

classes.name: AuditTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the Audit module in SuiteCRM, containing multiple unit test methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including setting up a mock user instance.

methods.name: testAudit
methods.description: Tests creation of an Audit bean and verifies its type and attributes.

methods.name: testget_summary_text
methods.description: Tests the get_summary_text method of Audit bean for cases with and without a set name.

methods.name: testget_audit_list
methods.description: Verifies that the get_audit_list method returns an array.

methods.name: testgetAssociatedFieldName
methods.description: Tests the getAssociatedFieldName method for different field names.
